```sh
kafka acl remove <principals...>
```

Delete every ACL matching a filter, per principal

## Arguments

| Argument        | Description                                |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `principals...` | principals whose matching ACLs are removed |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Unspecified resource type, pattern type, operation and permission filters default to any. Principal selection still limits the removal.

## Before you run

Revokes matching authorization bindings. Broad any filters can remove multiple permissions. Save the existing bindings before removal so they can be recreated.

## Flags

| Flag                         | Description                                        |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`         | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092   |
| `--resource-type <string>`   | limit to this resource type (default: any)         |
| `--resource-name <string>`   | limit to this exact resource name                  |
| `--pattern-type <string>`    | limit to this resource pattern type (default: any) |
| `--host <string>`            | limit to this host                                 |
| `--operation <string>`       | limit to this operation (default: any)             |
| `--permission-type <string>` | limit to this permission type (default: any)       |
| `--yes`                      | confirm the deletion without an interactive prompt |

## Examples

```sh
kafka acl remove User:alice --resource-type topic --resource-name orders --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "results": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
